services.name: Admission
services.desc: We are a community supported, non-profit children’s museum. Your admission keeps us up & running! Thank you for investing in keeping play in Onslow County. Admission: $8+tax for adults and children 1 year and over. Babies 12 months and younger are free. Admission is for sale at the front office, and no reservation is required. Your admission is good all day, so you’re welcome to leave and return same day. Payments: We accept all major credit cards (including American Express and Discover,) cash and our touchless ways to pay include: Apple Pay, Tap payments. (No checks, please.)
